dedupe_keys.name: nepal quake watch earthquake and exposure preparation pipeline

description: Nepal Quake Watch combines earthquake events, USGS ShakeMap intensity, Nepal census population, health-facility locations, government impact reports and boundaries for a static hazard dashboard. Its repository contains Python scripts that build reference layers and refresh event data, as well as generated JSON outputs and a source register. The README documents a census-ward exposure calculation and validation checks before publication. Coverage is Nepal, with USGS and Nepalese seismic catalogues that may disagree; event feeds update on a schedule, while reference layers change less often. The code is MIT and public without an account, but source layers have different licences and completeness limits. The author warns that hospital distances are straight lines, OSM health coverage is incomplete, government impacts lag, a ward census sum is 0.82 percent below the published national total, and emergency numbers remain unverified. A modeller can prepare earthquake exposure or critical-facility context, but should not treat the dashboard as an alert or infer actual road access. It complements data-usgs-comcat-earthquake-catalog by joining Nepal-specific exposure inputs. No script, downloaded layer or displayed event value was independently tested. Simulation use is limited to preparation and testing of earthquake exposure inputs.
licence: MIT code; USGS, Nepal government, OSM, OCHA and other input layers retain their own rights.
